source: services of the European Environment Agency, https://image.discomap.eea.europa.eu/arcgis/rest/services/GioLandPublic
citation: European Environment Agency, Copernicus Land Monitoring Service: High Resolution Layers Tree Cover Density and Forest Type
units: see 'content' of each variable; 255 = no data

variables.name: Tree_Cover_Density_classes_2012
variables.content: tree cover density in five classes: 0 = no trees or outside of the covered area, 1 = 1-20 %, 2 = 21-40 %, 3 = 41-60 %, 4 = 61-80 %, 5 = 81-100 %, 254 = unclassifiable. The percent values of this year are not offered by the service.

variables.name: Tree_Cover_Density_classes_2015
variables.content: tree cover density in five classes: 0 = no trees or outside of the covered area, 1 = 1-20 %, 2 = 21-40 %, 3 = 41-60 %, 4 = 61-80 %, 5 = 81-100 %, 254 = unclassifiable. The percent values of this year are not offered by the service.

variables.name: HRL_TreeCoverDensity_2018
variables.content: tree cover density in percent (0-100), mean of the 10 m data within the pixel, 255 = no data

variables.name: HRL_Forest_Type_2012_100m1103
variables.content: forest type: 0 = no forest or outside of the covered area, 1 = broadleaved forest, 2 = coniferous forest, 254 = unclassifiable

variables.name: HRL_Forest_Type_2015_100m18936
variables.content: forest type: 0 = no forest or outside of the covered area, 1 = broadleaved forest, 2 = coniferous forest, 254 = unclassifiable

variables.name: HRL_ForestType_2018
variables.content: forest type, most frequent value of the 10 m data within the pixel: 0 = no forest, 1 = broadleaved forest, 2 = coniferous forest, 255 = no data
